title: X-Content-Type-Options header missing
description: The observed response carries no X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header, so browsers may MIME-sniff the response and treat untrusted content as an executable type.
remediation: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on all responses and return accurate Content-Type values for served resources.
limitation: Presence-only: the header value is not inspected, so a present-but-wrong value still passes this check.
